Purpose: Normalize RNAseq raw counts
- Removing filtering inactive genes
- Normalization for gene length
- Normalization for library size
Input: 
- data/raw/counts_subset.RData
- gene lengths from ensembl release 113
Ouput: data/processed/counts_GeTMM.RData

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(txdbmaker)
library(GenomicFeatures)
```

# load counts

```{r}
load("data/raw/counts_subset.RData")
```

gene names in rna data is like ENSGXXXXXX.X
need to remove .X
```{r}
counts_subset_clean <- counts_subset %>%
  mutate(gene = str_extract(Name, "ENSG[0-9]{11}")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Name)
```

# filter out inactive genes
```{r}
counts_subset_clean <- counts_subset_clean %>%
  column_to_rownames('gene')

genes_to_keep <- filterByExpr(as.matrix(counts_subset_clean))

counts_subset_clean_active <- counts_subset_clean[genes_to_keep,]
```

# correct for gene length

## download gene length data from ensembl

for gtex v11 genes were aligned on gencode v47 which uses ensembl release 113
```{r}
options(timeout = 2400)  # 40 minutes
download.file("https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-113/gtf/homo_sapiens/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.113.gtf.gz", 
              destfile = "data/raw/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.113.gtf.gz", mode = "wb")

txdb <- txdbmaker::makeTxDbFromGFF("data/raw/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.113.gtf.gz", format = "gtf")

# Compute exon lengths per gene
exons_list_per_gene <- exonsBy(txdb, by = "gene")

# for each gene, reduce all the exons to a set of non overlapping exons, calculate their lengths (widths) and sum then
exonic_gene_sizes <- sum(width(GenomicRanges::reduce(exons_list_per_gene)))

# Divide by 1k to get kilobases 
exonic_gene_sizes <- exonic_gene_sizes/1000
```

Compare gene ids between df_RNA and genecode
All genes in the count data should be in the length df
Otherwise, there is probably a mismatch between the gtex and ensembl releases used
```{r}
counts_subset_clean_active <- counts_subset_clean_active %>%
  rownames_to_column('gene')

setdiff(counts_subset_clean_active$gene, names(exonic_gene_sizes)) 
```

## calculate fragment per kilobase (FPK)

add length to RNA data
dividing expression value by length
then remove exonic gene size colum
group by gene and sum (for when multiple ensembl version existed)

```{r}
counts_lenght_corrected <- counts_subset_clean_active %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  left_join(data.frame(exonic_gene_sizes, gene = names(exonic_gene_sizes)), by = 'gene') %>% #add length
  mutate(across(-c('gene', exonic_gene_sizes), ~.x/exonic_gene_sizes)) %>% #divide
  dplyr::select(-exonic_gene_sizes) %>% #remove length
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>% #sum per gene
  column_to_rownames('gene') #genes become rownames
```

# GeTMM transformation 
(library size correction)
```{r}
GeTMM <- DGEList(counts = counts_lenght_corrected)
GeTMM <- calcNormFactors(GeTMM,method = "TMM")
GeTMM <- cpm(GeTMM)
```

# add inactive genes back in as zeros
zeros will later be changed to a floor value
create a 0 filled matrix of the right size (size of counts df)
then replace values with GeTMM for active genes and leave rest empty

```{r}
df_counts_final <- matrix(data = 0, nrow = nrow(counts_subset_clean), ncol = ncol(counts_subset_clean), 
                      dimnames = list(rownames(counts_subset_clean), colnames(counts_subset_clean)))

df_counts_final[rownames(GeTMM), colnames(GeTMM)] <- GeTMM
```

verifications
```{r}
df_counts_final[genes_to_keep, ] # should have values
df_counts_final[!genes_to_keep, ] # should be zeros

all(df_counts_final[rownames(GeTMM), colnames(GeTMM)] == as.matrix(GeTMM)) # all the observations in GeTMM are in the final count file
```

# change zeros to a floor value (0.001)

not only inactive genes
because a gene could be considered active and still have 0/close to 0 values for a few sample
i don't think these values should be higher than the value given to inactive genes
so everything below 0.001 gets 0.001
```{r}
min(df_counts_final)
df_counts_final[df_counts_final <= 0.001] <- 0.001
min(df_counts_final)
```

# vizualise effect of normalization

```{r}
counts_subset_clean %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with('GTEX'), names_to = 'ID', values_to = 'raw_counts') %>%
  ggplot(., aes(log2(raw_counts), color = ID))+
  geom_density()+
  guides(color = 'none')+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title = 'Raw counts distribution')

GeTMM %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with('GTEX'), names_to = 'ID', values_to = 'GeTMM') %>%
  ggplot(., aes(log2(GeTMM), color = ID))+
  geom_density()+
  guides(color = 'none')+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title = 'GeTMM value distribution')

df_counts_final %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with('GTEX'), names_to = 'ID', values_to = 'GeTMM') %>%
  ggplot(., aes(log2(GeTMM), color = ID))+
  geom_density()+
  guides(color = 'none')+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title = 'GeTMM value distribution with inactive genes == 0.001')
```

save normalized counts
```{r}
dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save(df_counts_final, file = "data/processed/df_counts_final.RData")
write.csv(df_counts_final, file = "data/processed/df_counts_final.csv")
```
